units.source_text: 我从陵园前面的苗圃左边走进去，沿着两旁种着枫树的道路一直往里走。

en.t: I entered from the left side of the nursery in front of the cemetery and kept walking inward along a road lined with maples on both sides.

units.source_text: 这时，从陵园尽头的茶屋里突然走出一个先生模样的人，

en.t: Just then, from the teahouse at the far end of the cemetery, a man who looked like Sensei suddenly came out.

units.source_text: 他的眼镜框映着阳光，我一直走到他的身边，猛地喊了一声“先生”。

en.t: The rims of his glasses caught the sunlight, and I walked right up beside him and suddenly called out, "Sensei."

units.source_text: 先生突然停下脚步，望着我的脸，说道：“怎么会？……怎么会？……”

en.t: Sensei suddenly stopped, looked into my face, and said, "How is it possible? ... How is it possible? ..."

units.source_text: 他说了两遍同样的话，在白天的静寂中，这声音听起来有种异样的回响。

en.t: He said the same words twice, and in the stillness of the daytime the sound seemed to echo in a strangely uncanny way.
For a moment I could not answer at all.

units.source_text: “你是跟在我后面来的吗？怎么会……”

en.t: "Did you come here following after me? How could you ..."

units.source_text: 虽然先生的神色很平静，声音很低沉，但是他的表情中，却有着难以形容的阴影。

en.t: Although Sensei's manner was quite calm and his voice was low, there was an indescribable shadow in his expression.

units.source_text: 我便告诉先生我是怎么到这里来的。

en.t: So I told Sensei how I had come there.

units.source_text: “我来给人扫墓，我妻子告诉你那个人的名字了吗？”

en.t: "I came to visit someone's grave. Did my wife tell you that person's name?"

units.source_text: “是吗？——是啊，她和你初次见面，当然不会说的，也没有必要说的。”

en.t: "Is that so? Yes, of course she would not have told someone she had just met, and there was no need to tell you."

units.source_text: 先生露出自得的表情，可是我完全不明白他这话的意思。

en.t: Sensei looked satisfied with himself, but I did not understand at all what he meant by those words.
